subject: design/existing-repo-onboarding-v2
statement: detection reuses the existing ecosystem marker registry (go/python/node marker files); the plan **names every detected stack** and the required `executor.gate.<command>` action for each, and **invents no command** (`design-brainstorm:…#D-5`; `prd:existing-repo-onboarding/FR-7`, basis NG-1 detect-and-surface). A repository no marker matches yields a single `unknown stack — set your gate commands` plan line — never an error (UB-3). Detection's only output is the plan's `stack` block; it wires nothing.
